# Standalone executables do not need cgo or an SDK C compiler.
env GOOS=openharmony GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0
go build -o $WORK/buildid-arm64 cmd/buildid
env GOARCH=amd64
go build -o $WORK/buildid-amd64 cmd/buildid

# The command and runtime share the actual OpenHarmony target identity.
go env GOOS
stdout '^openharmony$'

# A stock downloaded host Go would lose this fork's target support.
env GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.999.0
! go env GOOS
stderr 'automatic toolchain switching is not supported on openharmony'
! stderr 'downloading'
